cells: Specialist Teacher Check-in (N08) records unresolved concerns. Every other student is also offered a shorter optional teacher check-in at N06T; do not ask the same questions twice.
Only show relevant questions. Reuse previous answers. Offer 'Not sure yet' and allow non-essential fields to remain blank.
No-data investigations still require teacher discussion before being pursued. Unresolved safeguarding, privacy or permissions must be resolved before affected actions.
A personalised summary is available before feedback. Plans can change after advice or findings; a teacher conversation is not required merely to export the PDF/Word.
Question wording is provisional. Availability of a summary on every teacher-advice route is an agreed requirement.
Which part of your idea would you like to discuss with your teacher?
This text appears in 'Questions for my teacher'.
What would you like to investigate mathematically without collecting a dataset?
Do not ask for primary/secondary sources; report data-readiness as Not applicable.

Course selection and outside-course maths may be recorded without data questions.

Preserve student explanation; suitability 'Not yet assessed' pending teacher.
What approval or advice is still needed before collecting or using the data?
Unresolved permission, consent, safeguarding or private data
Do not request individual participant details; do not collect or use affected data until approved.
What alternative or smaller version could you try if access is not secured?
Data inaccessible or practical barriers flagged
Retain earlier plan/rating, and show limitations honestly; no invented alternative.
What specific question will you ask your teacher?
Included in the printable summary as a concrete talking point.
What can you safely do next while waiting for advice?
Do not propose restricted collection; 'Discuss with teacher' is sufficient.
Is there anything else you want your teacher to know about the idea?
Preserve student notes if supplied; do not fabricate unanswered information.
Review and generate a provisional summary
Always, before or after teacher discussion
Export is NEVER blocked by lack of teacher feedback; prominently flag pending decisions.
Is there a mathematical pattern or claim you tentatively think might be true?
Use a mathematical conjecture rather than asking about distributions or correlations. Summary export remains available.
Why do you think that claim or pattern might hold?
If a tentative conjecture was entered
Capture their mathematical reasoning; no forced proof or automatic course rating.
